messages:
eli_support: Heads-up: account acct_4887 reported mismatch between dashboard and invoice for a streaming session. Dashboard shows ~9.2k tokens, invoice billed 13.4k. Ticket C-1229. Attaching session_id and raw logs below.

maria_cs: Thanks — can you paste the session id + approximate timeframe and whether they used client cancel or normal close?

eli_support: session_id=ses_2026-03-10-ACCT4887, timeframe ~2026-03-10T14:12Z. Customer says they forcibly closed their client (mobile app) mid-generation.

ramik_infra: Looking at logs for ses_2026-03-10-ACCT4887. Found this sequence:
```
{ "event":"chunk", "seq": 1, "tokens": 320 }
{ "event":"chunk", "seq": 2, "tokens": 480 }
{ "event":"chunk", "seq": 3, "tokens": 120, "partial": true }
{ "event":"client_disconnect", "code": 1006 }
{ "event":"reconnect", "seq_resume": 4 }
{ "event":"chunk", "seq": 4, "tokens": 820, "final": true }
{ "ledger": { "finalize_id": "f_9876", "tokens_billed": 13400 } }
```
The broker emitted a `partial:true` chunk then a disconnect. On reconnect the runtime replayed remaining tokens and wrote a final ledger entry. But I also see a later background finalizer job that ran and re-finalized the original stream when it marked it "terminated" after 30s, producing a second finalize event with 13400 tokens. Ledger shows two finalize records; invoice picked both.

ops_bot: Incident bot: alert created #INC-4532 (possible double-finalize on SSE client abort).

sana_billing: If ledger has two finalize entries we will double-count on invoice until we de-duplicate. Can you confirm ledger IDs?

ramik_infra: Confirmed finalize ids: f_9876 and f_9876-legacy. Second finalize was appended by the background finalizer which didn't check for `finalize_id` existence. Looks like a race: runtime finalizes on reconnect, background job finalizes on termination path without idempotency check.

maria_cs: Customer is asking for immediate remediation and credit. What's the severity and quick mitigation?

sana_billing: Recommend temporary credit for acct_4887 while engineering fixes duplication. We'll need timeline and exact token delta. From ledger: first entry 13400, second duplicate 13400 => billed 26800 vs dashboard 9200 (dashboard shows tokens counted by live session aggregator which suppressed duplicates). Delta ~17.6k tokens. I'll open a billing adjustment request once eng confirms root cause.

eli_support: Repro steps I used locally to simulate:
```
# start SSE stream
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"long run", "stream":true}' > /dev/null &
# kill client mid-chunk
sleep 2; pkill -9 curl
# reconnect with resume token
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?resume=ses_..." -d '{"resume":true}'
```
This produced two finalize events in our test ledger when background finalizer also ran.

ramik_infra: Proposed quick fix: make background finalizer check ledger for existing finalize_id or finalized flag before creating a new finalize record. Longer fix: make finalize writes idempotent by using a stable finalize key (session_id + attempt_id) and a DB upsert. I can open a PR against eng-runtime.

ops_bot: Pager: eng-runtime on-call @ramik_infra assigned.

ramik_infra: I'll push a hotfix to the finalizer to check for existing finalize_id and gate on a `finalized_at` timestamp. ETA for hotfix review: 2h. Post-hotfix we can run a backfill to collapse duplicates for affected accounts.

sana_billing: After hotfix, we need a list of affected accounts + finalize_ids so billing can void duplicate entries before next billing cycle. Also need a script to mark duplicate ledger rows as reconciled.

maria_cs: I'll notify the customer about temporary credit and that we are patching the finalizer.

eli_support: Notes for runbook:
- Detect pattern: session has both runtime finalize and background finalize within 60s with identical token count -> mark as duplicate candidate.
- Compensate: issue credit for (duplicate_tokens) and set account tag `billed-duplicate: true`.
- Repro: use quick kill + reconnect flow above.

ramik_infra: Follow-up: adding server-side guard to ignore background finalizer if session `state==finalized` OR `finalize_id` exists. Will include a migration to dedupe ledger entries older than 7 days.

eli_support: thanks everyone. Sana — if you want the ledger extract I can attach CSV. Maria — please send patience note to customer.

sana_billing: Please attach CSV to ticket and I'll start the adjustment. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Sending now. :wave:
